conditions.name: Fibromyalgia

ratingSchedule.note: DC 5025 expressly lists fibromyalgia (fibrositis, primary fibromyalgia syndrome) under the musculoskeletal rating schedule.

reviewNotes: Catalog-quality maintenance relocates fibromyalgia from the historical hemic/immune file into a musculoskeletal maintenance file after Wave 8 corrected its current 38 CFR 4.71a / DC 5025 identity. The historical 38 CFR 4.88b reference was a carryover and is not current fibromyalgia rating authority. Rating authority is not clinical nexus evidence.

conditions.name: Hip strain

ratingSchedule.note: Hip/thigh residual framework. Evaluate documented residuals under the applicable hip and thigh criteria, including DCs 5250-5255 as appropriate; no single hip-strain-specific diagnostic code is assigned.

reviewNotes: Wave 8 resolves the prior empty rating citation with the current hip/thigh framework rather than inventing a strain-specific diagnostic code. Clinical Evidence Promotion Batch 4 physically normalizes this stable identity into musculoskeletal maintenance. Rating authority describes evaluation only and is not clinical nexus evidence.
